issues.reason: The Cardinality note makes 'exactly N' emit the bare (Cardinality g N) with the 'no more' closure deliberately unencoded, and the (Only <filler> <event>) form requires an event this verbless existential never reifies — the unrecordable particle is the coverage gap the reviewer's own q2 names, not a parse defect.

A cardinality-1 group has explicit precedent — the partitive rule itself maps 'one of' to (Cardinality <S> 1) on a GroupOf subset — and every emitted atom is true and well-typed, so for the uncovered counted singular 'only one N' the group encoding is acceptable improvisation that, unlike a bare witness, preserves the count.
